## Slide 7 — MM503 / MM507

Availability of Dynamic shift registers. A sequential access memory.
Need to circulate to not lose its content.

:::

::: {.slide-notes}

## Slide 8 — CTC DataPoint-3300

First product. Datapoint 3300 72 characters by 25 lines. 1800 6-bit
characters using 36 MM507 chips.

:::

::: {.slide-notes}

## Slide 9 — CPU Board Annotated

To be able to connect to all sorts of mainframes and doing data entry
tasks a programmable terminal was needed. A programmabel terminal
required a CPU.\
Vic Poor, Harry Pyle and Jonathan Schmidt designed the instruction set
and architechture

:::
